validity.physiological_state: abstract BAN metadata exchange without physiological payload content
validity.description: Checks versioned request/response translation, identity echo, validity, and communication-only metric mapping through an external client boundary.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.5 BAN transport adapter contract
sources.role: replaceable BAN frame transport and result semantics

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.6 external network-simulator adapter contract
sources.role: metadata-only JSON boundary and external result mapping

limitations: The checked exchange uses a synthetic in-process fixture rather than ns-3 or another network simulator.
The adapter transports topology and timing metadata but deliberately omits biological and command payload content.
The external simulator owns channel, protocol, queue, interference, mobility, and capacity assumptions; MEHLISSA validates identity and result consistency but does not validate those external models.
The reference values are software-verification values and do not characterize a real BAN.
